findings.finding: The committed records describe this branch as AUTOMATIC: the compiled Delaware profile records that mandatory-eligible cases are expunged by the SBI monthly with no filing, and the committed contract records that a petition or correction path exists only where the automatic process did not occur.
findings.consequence: No court petition was composed. The packet is a request to the agency that runs the programme, plus a guidance page that says who runs it, what the participant does, and what the participant does NOT do. Composing a petition here would have invented a form for a route that has none.

findings.finding: The compiled profile gives a specific reachable authority for this branch: the SBI, on 302-739-5884.
findings.consequence: It is named on both composed pages and in every one of the four participant-facing obligations that needs an authority. DET-FEE-AND-WAIVER-001 requires an office identified well enough to actually reach, and a telephone number is that.

findings.finding: The MASTER_QUEUE row for this family carries the same overlay-directory naming as the petition families, and its implementationStrategy is custom_pleading.
findings.consequence: The strategy label describes how the pages are produced — composed from codified text rather than filled into an official PDF — and not that the output must be a pleading. The output here is a request and a guidance page, because that is what the committed records describe.
